mapper.select: select * from safety_enter_filing where fd_car_no = #{plateNumber} order by create_time desc limit 1

SELECT r.factory_name, r.factory_id, r.location_name, r.location_id, r.vehicle_type, r.plate_number, CASE r.in_out_type WHEN 1 THEN '进厂' WHEN 2 THEN '出厂' ELSE r.in_out_type END AS in_out_type, r.emp_name, r.emp_no, r.release_date, r.release_time, r.video_href, r.protect_grade, r.detailed_img, r.vin, r.engine_num, r.car_img, r.car_date, r.car_belong, r.driver_name, r.supplier_name, r.supplier_code, r.goods_name, r.goods_weight FROM Ytsafety_release_info r
ORDER BY r.release_date DESC, r.release_time DESC

SELECT r.factory_name, r.factory_id, r.location_name, r.location_id, r.vehicle_type, r.plate_number, CASE r.in_out_type WHEN 1 THEN '进厂' WHEN 2 THEN '出厂' ELSE r.in_out_type END AS in_out_type, r.emp_name, r.emp_no, r.release_date, r.release_time, r.video_href, r.protect_grade, r.detailed_img, r.vin, r.engine_num, r.car_img, r.car_date, r.car_belong, r.driver_name, r.supplier_name, r.supplier_code, r.goods_name, r.goods_weight FROM Ytsafety_release_info r
ORDER BY r.release_date DESC, r.release_time DESC

SELECT r.factory_name, r.factory_id, r.location_name, r.location_id, r.vehicle_type, r.plate_number, CASE r.in_out_type WHEN 1 THEN '进厂' WHEN 2 THEN '出厂' ELSE r.in_out_type END AS in_out_type, r.emp_name, r.emp_no, r.release_date, r.release_time, r.video_href, r.protect_grade, r.detailed_img, r.vin, r.engine_num, r.car_img, r.car_date, r.car_belong, r.driver_name, r.supplier_name, r.supplier_code, r.goods_name, r.goods_weight FROM Ytsafety_release_info r
ORDER BY r.release_date DESC, r.release_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
